main.text: CNESS Advantage
Show people the care behind your business

A conscious business considers how its decisions affect people, communities and the world around it. CNESSWORKS helps you review how your organization works, find ways to improve and share the progress you make. It also helps customers and other businesses find you.
Start where you are. Understand what you do well and what you can work on next.
Trust Profile
Give people one place to learn about your business
A Trust Profile brings your CNESS recognition and business practices together on one page. It shows which areas have been reviewed and your current recognition status.
Create Your Trust Profile
How CNESS helps
Bring your CNESS recognition details together.
Explain what has been reviewed.
Help customers understand your business before they contact you.
How you can use it
Share your profile with customers and business partners.
Use it to answer questions about the way you work.
What you gain
A clear reference people can check.
A place to share good practices from your organization.
What this means for your business
People can see the actions behind your commitments and decide whether your business meets their needs.
Spend more time discussing customer needs

A customer may want to know what your recognition covers before discussing a purchase. Your profile gives them a place to check. This can reduce repeated questions and leave more time to talk about how you can help.
Organization Certification
Turn your values into everyday action

CNESS reviews six areas of how your organization works. This review, called an assessment, helps you understand your progress and where you can improve. Certification is awarded when you meet the required CNESS standards.
Apply for Organization Certification
How CNESS helps
Review how your organization works.
Identify what needs attention.
Understand your current stage of progress.
How you can use it
Choose improvements based on the review.
Keep track of progress as you work towards renewal.
What you gain
A way to show how your values guide your work.
Clearer information for customers, employees and business partners.
Extra listing features through the Global Directory's Premium plan.
What this means for your business
Help people understand what your organization stands for and what you are doing about it.
Help buyers check how you work

Some buyers ask how you treat people, care for the environment and run your organization. Your certification can help answer questions about the areas reviewed. Each buyer decides whether the certification meets their own requirements.
Aspiring · Level One
Take your first steps
Aspiring is the foundation level. It focuses on understanding where you are now and choosing practical improvements.
Apply for Organization Certification
How CNESS helps
Understand your starting point.
Choose actions you can manage.
Keep records that show your progress.
How you can use it
Put your first improvements into practice.
Review what works and prepare for your next review.
What you gain
A clearer direction for improving your organization.
A way to support your commitments with real examples.
What this means for your business
Start making changes you can explain and build on over time.
Understand the three levels

Aspiring: build your foundation. Inspired: show the improvements you have made. Luminary: show well-established practices and share what you have learned. Begin with the free Analyze tool to explore where your organization stands, then consider your next step towards certification.
Inspired · Level Two
Show the progress you have made
Inspired focuses on improvements you have put into practice and can show through records or results.
Apply for Organization Certification
How CNESS helps
Recognize progress you can show.
Explain what has changed in your organization.
Learn by comparing practices with other organizations.
How you can use it
Keep improving after you receive recognition.
Record the changes you make to support your renewal.
What you gain
A clearer way to explain how you put your values into action.
Opportunities to connect with customers who value your approach.
Opportunities to work with other businesses.
What this means for your business
Help people see your progress and find others with similar goals.
Help people understand your workplace

People considering a job with you want to know how you treat employees. Sharing practices that have been reviewed can help explain what working with you is like. The everyday experience you provide remains important to attracting people and helping them stay.
Get recognized, and help people find your business
Luminary · Level Three
Help others learn from your experience
Luminary recognizes well-established practices and results you can demonstrate. It also gives you opportunities to share what you have learned.
Apply for Organization Certification
How CNESS helps
Recognize the practices and results you can show.
Share experience other organizations can use.
Explore opportunities to give talks and guide others.
How you can use it
Help other businesses improve.
Keep records of your work and contributions to support continued recognition.
What you gain
A way to show the quality and reliability of your work.
Opportunities to lead by example in your industry.
What this means for your business
Use your experience to help improve how businesses in your industry work.
Help banks and investors understand your business

Banks and investors make their own checks before providing money. Your certification can help explain the areas CNESS has reviewed. They will also need financial and other business information before making a decision.
Product Certification
Show customers what has been checked
CNESS reviews a product against requirements for specific areas. A product is certified when it meets the requirements for the areas reviewed. This helps customers understand what has been checked.
Apply for Product Certification
How CNESS helps
Make clear what the product review covers.
Answer customer questions with information from the review.
Identify areas where the product can improve.
How you can use it
Seek reviews for more products or additional areas when needed.
Use customer feedback and later reviews to keep the information useful.
What you gain
A clearer way to explain the care behind your product.
Information that can help new customers consider it.
What this means for your business
Give customers reasons they can understand when deciding whether your product is right for them.
Explain what customers get for the price
Customers want to understand what they are paying for. Information about the qualities covered by your product certification can help explain its value. They can then make a more informed choice.
Global Directory
Help customers and partners find you
The CNESS Global Directory is an online place where people can find organizations and learn about their work.
Explore the Global Directory
How CNESS helps
Give people another way to find your business.
Show useful information about what you do.
Help visitors search and contact businesses that interest them.
How you can use it
Share information about your business and what you offer.
See whether the people who contact you are a good fit for your business.
What you gain
A business profile people can find and share.
Opportunities to connect with conscious organizations across more than 90 countries.
What this means for your business
People can learn about your business and find out how to contact you.
Be seen through CNESS

Certified organizations gain visibility through the directory and CNESS partners. The planned 11 November launch features 108 Founding Conscious Products. It will introduce the CNESS standard to a wider audience. Early participants can help shape its development.
Choose your Global Directory plan

Choose the support you need to present your organization or product and help people find it. Free includes the standard certification process and a basic listing. Premium adds help with telling your story and promoting your business.
Free
Start with the standard review and a basic directory listing.
A standard assessment and independent review.
Certification when you meet the required standards.
No extra services to promote your business.
Business Listing — Add your organization to the directory.
Company Introduction — Tell people what your business does.
Search Visibility — Help visitors find you by industry and location.
Website and Contact Details — Show people how to reach you.
Shareable Profile Link — Send your listing to customers and partners.
Regional Listing — Have your business listed for your region.
Choose Free
Most popular
Premium
Get more help presenting your business and reaching people.
Everything in the Free plan.
CNESS interviews about your organization or product.
Extra help explaining your purpose and what you offer.
A place in the B2C Global Directory. B2C means business to consumer: this directory is for individual customers looking for businesses.
Featured Placement — Appear more prominently in selected parts of the directory.
Expanded Business Profile — Share more about your goals, team, achievements and business story.
Products and Services Showcase — Describe what you sell and show it with images.
Best Practices Highlights — Share real examples of how your business works responsibly.
Priority Listing Support — Get help setting up and updating your listing.
International Listing — Have your business listed for an international audience.
Choose Premium

The same certification standards for every plan. Free and Premium use the same certification standards. Paying for Premium gives you extra help promoting your business. It does not change your assessment score or the decision to award certification.
Partners and Business Connections
Use your experience to help other organizations
Become a CNESS partner to help organizations understand and work towards certification, while building connections of your own.
Become a Partner
How CNESS helps
Find opportunities that fit your skills and interests.
Learn about an organization before discussing how you could work together.
Explore opportunities to introduce organizations and earn partner income under agreed terms.
How you can use it
Make useful introductions and build working relationships.
Discuss roles and payment arrangements before agreeing to work together.
What you gain
A way to use your skills to support other organizations.
Opportunities to build your network and work with others.
What this means for your business
Connect with people who can use your experience, and help them take practical steps towards certification.
Share what works, and keep improving
Best Practices and Shared Knowledge
Share useful ideas and learn from others
Best practices are useful ways of doing things that others can learn from. Share examples from your organization and learn from what others have done.
Share Your Best Practices
How CNESS helps
Find ideas for areas you want to improve.
Help others learn about your skills and experience.
Find learning materials, including premium resources.
How you can use it
Try ideas that suit your organization.
Check whether they improve the way you work.
What you gain
A place to share practices that others can learn from.
Ideas from organizations around the world.
A way to show how your organization makes decisions and takes responsibility for them.
What this means for your business
Keep learning while helping others improve. Show what you do through examples people can understand.
Build a record of how you work

Keep records of your decisions, actions and improvements. They help people understand how your organization works over time. Certification adds a reference to the areas CNESS has reviewed, which can help when customers or partners have questions.
Connect with people through the CNESS SuperApp
The CNESS SuperApp helps people discover your business and connect with you. Use it to explain your work, hear from potential customers and meet people with shared interests.
Meet people who care about similar things
Introduce your business to people who care about responsible choices and positive change.
Help people recognize your business
Share a clear, consistent story about what you do and why it matters.
Talk with potential customers
Listen to what people need, answer their questions and explain how your business can help.
Explain what your business stands for
Tell people what matters to your organization and how it guides your decisions.
Show how you support communities
Share examples of actions your organization has taken to support people and communities.
Meet people in other countries
Connect with people who may want to work with your business, become partners or support your work.
Explore the CNESS SuperApp
Find your starting point
Use the Analyze tool for a free first look at where your organization stands. Start with the information you already have, then decide whether to apply for certification.
Start Your Free Analysis
Apply for Certification
